DB-IP Lite City data

IP Geolocation by DB-IP: https://db-ip.com
Download and coverage: https://db-ip.com/db/download/ip-to-city-lite
License: Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International (CC BY 4.0)
License terms: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/

The optional updater downloads the original monthly MMDB archive from DB-IP's
official HTTPS distribution, decompresses it, and records the resulting file
hash and release month. The application displays DB-IP attribution with the
IP lookup tool. Database contents are stored separately from the application
image. PND's MIT source license does not replace the dataset's CC BY terms.

DB-IP city names may be matched against the separately attributed GeoNames
snapshot to offer user-confirmed candidate identifiers. These candidates are
PND suggestions and are not GeoNames identifiers supplied by DB-IP. Approximate
IP locations are not guarantees of a physical server's precise location.
